decisions.reason: As the current analytics standard and a natural fit with our shop-technology and measurement positioning, this plugin should be continued because the investment is still recent and any adoption frictions can plausibly be seen as temporary.

Despite our recent investment, the Universal Analytics plugin should be withdrawn because the underlying platform is structurally obsolete in 2024, so weak prospects cannot credibly be justified as temporary.

The retail system interface plugin matches our core integration capabilities and client needs, and with resources already committed there is a strong tendency to continue while giving the product more time to prove itself.

This service has the strongest visible public commitment through its own page and is central to our broader relaunch, SEO, and conversion offering, which makes management likely to persist even if early results were mixed.
